name: Sombrevex
description: Sombrevex selectively attenuates amygdala activity during sleep while preserving overall REM architecture, eliminating the fear-response cascades that generate nightmares without blocking dreams entirely. Developed originally for military contractors experiencing chrome-rejection trauma, it has become the standard-of-care prescription for combat PTSD, cyberware integration disorder, and Shelf-violence survivors.
effects: Elimination of nightmare content during sleep
Preserved dream activity with neutral-to-positive emotional valence
side_effects: Emotional blunting bleeds into waking hours with prolonged use
Suppression of fear response during sleep can reduce waking threat-detection sensitivity
Dreams become progressively bland and affectless — some users describe 'grey dreams'
Abrupt cessation causes nightmare rebound of severe intensity
street_price: Φ18 per patch (Tier 2-3); Φ6 on Shelf (subsidized gray market)
cultural_context: Sombrevex is quietly ubiquitous across all tiers but for different reasons. Shelf residents use it to survive the psychological aftermath of violence and chrome-rejection seizures. Tier 4 corporate workers use it to suppress performance anxiety dreams. Veterans of the corporate security wars use it to stay functional. Lazarus Pharmaceuticals lobbied hard to keep it widely available — the dependency it creates is gentle and durable, and the rebound effect on cessation ensures users rarely stop voluntarily.
story_hooks: A chrome-rejection trauma survivor stops taking Sombrevex cold-turkey and begins having nightmares so specific and detailed they appear to be memories of crimes they didn't commit — or didn't commit consciously.

Lazarus Pharmaceuticals has been embedding micro-dose behavioral conditioning agents in certain Sombrevex patch batches distributed on the Shelf — suppressing nightmares while quietly reducing aggression and resistance in the population most likely to riot.

A Tier 4 fixer who hasn't dreamed of anything frightening in four years goes off Sombrevex to process a genuine threat — and discovers their fear response has atrophied to the point where they can no longer feel danger in time to act on it.
